correctness.rationale: Normalized Haar integration yields the exact four-by-four Toeplitz Gram coefficients b0=2α/π, b1=A x, b2=A cosα(2x²-1), b3=A(4cos²α-1)(4x³-3x)/3, with x=cos(θ/2), A=2sinα/π. Reversal symmetry gives two two-by-two blocks. At antipodal x=0 the smallest eigenvalue m-B has multiplicity two and lower eigenspace (u,v,u,v). Exact polynomial expansion of the averaged shifted determinants is -(4/3)A²sin²α x⁴, so for x>0 at least one shifted eigenvalue is negative. The positive eigenvalue is ≤4A, yielding the stated explicit quartic global deficit. At x=0 the two simple lower block eigenvalues have slopes ±2A sin²α in x, so the combined least eigenvalue has cusp 2sin³α/π·(π-θ)+Oα((π-θ)²). The 2α≤θ≤π and 0<α<π/2 domains were observed. Independent symbolic determinant simplification held exactly; the previous four-mode checker additionally verifies independent quadrature. No finite sampling substitutes for the algebraic proof.

Marceca et al bound intermediate concentration spectral counts, not local four-mode shape derivatives.

The genuinely additional final component is the four-mode lower eigenspace of dimension two and its nonzero sharp one-sided LINEAR cusp coefficient. It is not implied by the prior three-mode lower bound, which offers no local upper bound on four-mode deficit. Best-of-knowledge this structural cusp is new; the original package overstates novelty of its global bound, a bibliographic interpretation risk not a false mathematical inequality.
